policy: Example preferences based on the requested Luna/GLM mix, not measured capability rankings. Human verifies model IDs, effort support and quota before marking ready. Lead may choose any enabled ready Peer option within the assignment budget; reassess suitability for fallback.

options.notes: Intended default for familiar implementation. Use a reasoning option when lifecycle or ownership is undecided. Quota status is maintained by Human.
Intended for deeper contract analysis and falsification. Prefer a fresh independent session for review; this preference does not establish a benchmark ranking.
Requested Pi option for another design/review perspective. Human evaluates suitability for difficult code before using it as a coding fallback. Quota and credentials belong to this Pi model endpoint.
Devin swe-2 medium tier for clear, well-scoped tasks with a known implementation path. Mirrors the Human's Devin SWE-2 Medium profile; devin options accept swe-2 models only.
Devin swe-2 high tier for codebase exploration, root-cause analysis and choosing between approaches. Mirrors the Human's Devin SWE-2 High profile.
Devin swe-2 max tier for ambiguous or critical tasks with large blast radius or failed prior attempts. Mirrors the Human's Devin SWE-2 Max profile; reserve for work that justifies the strongest tier.
